$comment: Limits the report guardrails enforce. The AI service applies all of them; the API applies those marked in contracts/README.md again, independently. Authoritative: edit here, then run `npm run contracts`.

withdrawalReasons.unlikelyHypothesis: it would change production on the strength of a hypothesis rated unlikely
withdrawalReasons.noIncident: it would change production, and the evidence supports {outcome}, not an incident with an established cause

nextStepPrefixes.highRisk: Higher-risk alternative, only if the lower-risk action is not possible: {title}. {description}
